items.title: No. 22 Arizona football falls short against No. 2 Utah in instant classic
items.summary:
The No. 22 Arizona football team (7-3, 4-3 in Big 12) suffered a heartbreaking loss to No. 2 University of Utah (10-0, 7-0 in Big 12), 40-39 on Saturday, Nov. 14, in Casino Del Sol Stadium. The Wildcats dropped their second loss in the last three games and have been officially eliminated from the Big 12 Championship.

“To me, this night, the way it went from start to finish, I think really speaks to our belief, our resilience and our response,” head coach Brent Brennan said. “Just the way our guys responded all night, I thought, was really, really special.”
